'''Andrea Malchiodi''' (born September 30, 1972) is an Italian [[mathematician]] who is active in the fields of [[partial differential equation]]s and [[calculus of variations]], with several contributions to [[geometric analysis]].

==Scientific activity==
Malchiodi received his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[International School for Advanced Studies]] in 2000 under the supervision of [[Antonio Ambrosetti]].{{Citation needed|date=December 2019}} He is a professor of mathematics at the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa|Scuola Normale Superiore]] at Pisa. He was previously professor of mathematics at the [[International School for Advanced Studies]] and at the [[University of Warwick]].{{Citation needed|date=December 2019}} Malchiodi has developed topological and analytical methods allowing to deal with a number of questions in geometric analysis, such as the [[Yamabe problem]], the  [[scalar curvature]] problem, problems coming from fourth order [[conformal geometry]] and concentration for singular perturbation problems.<ref>{{cite web|title=Caccioppoli prize citation|url=http://umi.dm.unibo.it/caccioppoli/vincitori-en.html#2006|publisher=Italian Mathematical Union|accessdate=May 5, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171011071928/http://umi.dm.unibo.it/caccioppoli/vincitori-en.html#2006|archive-date=October 11, 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Existence of conformal metrics with constant Q-curvature|url=https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2008/168-3/p03|publisher=Annals of Mathematics|accessdate=June 12, 2013}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Q-curvature flow on S4|journal=Journal of Differential Geometry|volume=73|pages=1–44|url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS?service=UI&version=1.0&verb=Display&handle=euclid.jdg/1146680511|accessdate=June 12, 2013|doi=10.4310/jdg/1146680511|year=2006|last1=Malchiodi|first1=Andrea|last2=Struwe|first2=Michael|doi-access=free}}</ref> In particular, he proved some new intricate forms of improved Moser-[[Neil Trudinger|Trudinger]] inequalities allowing to prove existence results for singular [[Joseph Liouville|Liouville]] equations.<ref>{{cite journal|title=New Improved Moser–Trudinger Inequalities and Singular Liouville Equations on Compact Surfaces|journal=Geometric and Functional Analysis|volume=21|issue=5|pages=1196–1217|doi=10.1007/s00039-011-0134-7|year=2011|last1=Malchiodi|first1=Andrea|last2=Ruiz|first2=David|arxiv=1007.3861|s2cid=119317846 }}</ref> Similar types of inequalities allow to prove existence results for Toda systems on surfaces.<ref>{{cite journal|title=A Variational Analysis of the Toda System on Compact Surfaces|journal=Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics|volume=66|issue=3|pages=332–371|doi=10.1002/cpa.21433|year=2013|last1=Malchiodi|first1=Andrea|last2=Ruiz|first2=David|arxiv=1105.3701|s2cid=119633018 }}</ref> Malchiodi has been visiting professor in many universities and institutions, amongst which are [[Stanford University]], [[Institute for Advanced Study|The Institute for Advanced Study]] at Princeton, and [[ETH Zurich|ETH]] at Zurich.{{Citation needed|date=December 2019}}  He belongs to the editorial board of several mathematical journals and is one of the managing editors of the journal Calculus of Variations & PDE.<ref>{{cite web|title=Calculus of Variations & PDE|url=https://www.springer.com/mathematics/analysis/journal/526|accessdate=January 19, 2014}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Malchiodi was awarded the [[Caccioppoli Prize|Caccioppoli prize]] in 2006.{{Citation needed|date=December 2019}}  In 2005 he was awarded, jointly with Antonio Ambrosetti, the [[Ferran Sunyer i Balaguer]] prize.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ferran Sunyer i Balaguer prize |url=http://ffsb.iec.cat/EN/premi.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070702230051/http://ffsb.iec.cat/EN/premi.htm |url-status=dead |archive-date=July 2, 2007 |accessdate=May 5, 2013 }}</ref> Malchiodi was included in the list of invited speakers at the 2014 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Seoul.<ref>[http://www.icm2014.org/en/program/scientific/section Sectional invited speakers at the 2014 International Congress of Mathematicians] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130718160747/http://www.icm2014.org/en/program/scientific/section |date=2013-07-18 }}</ref>
